text: D3a-12 opened. Read: QD3-004 (answered at D3a-11: amend G4a to cover link lines, backwards; done at D3a-11) and QD3-005 (count first; done at D3a-11). J's message, 18 October 23:22 Berlin, on the count: 'Extend G4a to the 16 instantiate and restrict lines and apply it backwards. Before ruling on A07's bound, set out your wider reading and the lines that rest on it; keep those as ruled until I decide.' What rested on my assumption: my meanwhile held every instantiate and restrict ruling as written, which both answers kept, so nothing is undone; the 16 now move except those that rest on the wider reading of A07's bound. How I read J's message: (1) G4a, by a dated amendment, covers instantiate and restrict lines; backwards it reaches the 16 counted lines (_analysis/d3_qd3005_count.jsonl, would = specification). (2) First, before any A07 line is ruled, I set out in notes-D3.md the D3a-09 wider reading of A07's bound and every ledger line that rests on it, whatever its op and leg. (3) Lines that rest on the wider reading keep their present ruling: the 8 instantiate and restrict elaborations stay elaborations, and the add and link lines re-ruled at D3a-11 on that reading stay specifications naming A07, until J decides. (4) The 16 lines that rest on the bound's own words (hour 73 cut the work unfinished) or on other statements are ruled now: Madeon-006, redpandas-013, yuyuyu-005 and the A07 lines whose concepts show the close cutting the work, each checked by its concepts' hours. (5) The three lines the count found outside the 16 (thailand-008, uncertain; AcePlace-029 and TransFlagPlace-003, a clause-4 pairing) are not in J's 16; they stay as ruled and I ask J. (6) Forward, G4a covers instantiate and restrict lines in the groups still to rule. Re-orientation: elements, arrows and history are as I read them after the D3a-11 compaction (30, 21 and 139 lines; no move since)

Set out in notes-D3.md (section D3a-12), before any A07 line was ruled: G4a's amendment for instantiate and restrict lines (18 October, J), and my wider reading of A07's bound. The bound's words name a work the close cut unfinished; since D3a-09 (G16) I read it as any marking where no finished work stands. 28 lines cite the reading, by their concepts' hours (cite.py or my reasons): 9 match the bound's words (albania-032, chess-011, homelab-034, homelab-035, ultrahardcore-031; aeon-013, aeon-016, chess-056, chess-059); 3 are mixed (kamenrider-021, kamenrider-022: goal failed by hour 59.9, the eye marked at 73.17; aeskwadraat-016: the close stopped a plan with no work placed); 16 mark a work lost, given up or left unfinished before the close (Thegreatblackhole-038, battlecats-048, battlecats-049, columbia-049, columbia-050, columbia-052, faeria-048, indonesia-056, indonesia-059, raocow-022, raocow-057, warthunder-057, warthunder-058, mizzou-011, portal-048, wsu-037). The 19 resting on the wider reading keep their rulings until J decides: 8 instantiate and restrict elaborations, 9 add, link and P12 specifications naming A07, 2 absent rejects. Not resting: 42 P11 absent evidence limits that test 'nor an attempt marked', pebble-032, ReBoot-053. Slip found: my D3a-11 reason for raocow-057 says 'a work cut unfinished by hour 73', but c0052 ('we had it up for a couple hours') shows it lost before the close; the ruling stays, as J asks

asked QD3-006: QD3-006. You extended G4a to the 16 instantiate and restrict lines, applied backwards. Two points on its reach. (1) Forward: I read the extension as covering instantiate and restrict lines in the groups still to rule, so that one form gets one kind whatever its op. (2) Backwards, the count found three more lines that G4a's other clauses would touch, outside your 16. thailand-008 (R01 restrict, a one-room particular) separates the member who starts an enlargement from the first start; clause 2 would make it a specification naming P02's 'adds to it or enlarges it', but the line is about whom the coder took as the starter, so clause 3 (a coding rule, ruled by its concepts) may govern it. AcePlace-029 and TransFlagPlace-003 (R01 instantiate particulars) each show a start on a board opened after the close; nothing in the model states it, but two rooms show it, so clause 4 would pair them as one paired elaboration instead of two particulars. Should the extension apply forward, and should it reach these three lines backwards? | meanwhile: Meanwhile I read the extension as applying forward to instantiate and restrict lines in later groups, and the three lines stay as ruled

asked QD3-007: QD3-007. As you asked, my wider reading of A07's bound and the lines that rest on it are set out in notes-D3.md, section D3a-12. The bound's words name one case: 'Where hour 73 cut the work unfinished, the room marks the attempt instead.' Since D3a-09 (G16) I have read it as any marking where no finished work stands: also a part left after the goal failed, a work lost, erased or given up before the close, and a plan the close stopped. 28 lines cite the reading. 9 match the bound's words; I rule the 5 instantiate and restrict lines among them now. 3 are mixed and 16 mark a work lost, given up or left unfinished before the close. Those 19 keep their rulings: 8 instantiate and restrict paired elaborations (Thegreatblackhole-038, mizzou-011 among them), 9 add, link and P12 specifications naming A07 (battlecats-049, columbia-050 among them), and 2 absent rejects (aeskwadraat-016, wsu-037). Should A07's bound be read as widely as I have read it? Or should it be kept to the close cutting the work? Then the 9 specifications return to paired elaborations unless another statement holds them, the 8 stay, the 2 rejects are read again, and G16 is amended. A third choice, carried since D3a-09 to A07's group, is to state the form in P11's own statement, which would be a revision of the element. | meanwhile: Meanwhile the 19 lines keep their rulings, and no other line is ruled on the wider reading

Kept as ruled: the 19 lines on the wider reading (QD3-007) and thailand-008, AcePlace-029, TransFlagPlace-003 (QD3-006). No move. validate.py D3: 10,803 of 42,243 ruled, 0 errors, 2 old warnings; ledger 11,466 (663 appended re-rulings). Pair check: 11 cross-kind pairs, the 7 older and 4 on the wider reading. History 139, elements 30, arrows 21, findings 37, tier history 561, unchanged. Head 3,000 words; links resolve. Open: QD3-006, QD3-007; the second blind re-rule check before the D3c freeze. Next: the next element group's lines

Group opened: P08 (T4-016, Negotiated order; borders, truces and deals), alone, as one element with many lines; P21, the field's tentative entry under the same fourth-order theme, takes its own group. 969 lines in 703 rooms, none ruled: instantiate 589, add-step 127, add-condition 68, link 36, restrict 16, absent 133 (unobserved 129, not-testable 4; none evidenced). No finding touches P08 (mem.py findings --touching). Arrows: A04 into it, A05, A14 and A21 out, A17 from P09. Rule G18 written to notes-D3.md before any line is ruled: P08 is shown when a concept shows the room and another room talking terms about where their works meet or how each treats the other's work (propose, settle, contest, hold to; by members, envoys or chats; read from either room's record; a report that terms exist counts). Not shown: sparing with no terms (P07), help terms only (P16), attack (P09), taunts (P18), mutual defence alliances (P17), locating by neighbours. Candidates and tentative entries do not hold a line under G4a: a hosting regime is P19's form and a dispute over who may commit the room is P21's, both paired elaborations, the latter carried to P21's group. Absent lines by G2 and G3, never corrections; restrict by G9; add, link, instantiate and restrict lines by G4a as amended (forward, per QD3-006's meanwhile); G1b draws, one per 100-line instantiate packet

J answered QD3-006 and QD3-007 during the leg (read with mem.py asks). QD3-006, J's leaning: apply the extension forward; thailand-008 stays; pair AcePlace-029 and TransFlagPlace-003; 'do what you judge best, and record why'. My judgment: the same. Forward was my meanwhile, so nothing rests on a wrong assumption. thailand-008 stays a particular: its line is about whom the coder took as the starter (clause 3), and its concept (an apology for a third flag meant to enlarge the work) shows no start. AcePlace-029 and TransFlagPlace-003 each show a start on a board opened after the close; two rooms show the same form and no statement holds it, so clause 4 pairs them, as successor canvases are paired elsewhere. QD3-007, J's leaning: state the wider form in P11's own statement, as a revision, rather than stretch A07's bound; or keep the bound to the close; 'judge which is best, and record why'. My judgment: keep A07's bound to its own words and do not revise P11. Why: (1) P11's fourth-order theme T4-026 is declared a completion ritual, 'the room's marking of its finished work', with prose and counts over 522 rooms; revising P11 would also need that construct amended, for a family of about 16 rooms; (2) no line shows P11's statement failing (no corrections); rooms that mark an ended attempt add a form beside it, which is the subform level the method keeps for D4's clustering, and widening the element's condition comes close to loosening it until the rooms fit (rule 12); (3) the close's own case already has a home in A07's bound. Consequence, by a dated amendment to G16 applied backwards: marking an attempt that was lost, given up or left unfinished before the close, or where no work was placed, is a paired elaboration of P11 that no statement holds. Re-rulings: the 9 add, link and P12 lines that named A07 on the wider reading become paired elaborations within the family; the 2 absent rejects are read again; mizzou-011 and warthunder-058 keep their kind with reasons that no longer say A07's bound names them; AcePlace-029 and TransFlagPlace-003 become a paired elaboration. The 9 lines on the bound's own words keep their rulings. No move
